title: CYBRIK approval request v1
description: A Fabric-originated request for human approval of a gated action, delivered to SOC (strategy 05 §5.4). This contract is the durable, digest-bound approval-ingress interface that ADR-0004 F9 records as an OPEN dependency and that suite release blocker RB-001 tracks; the interface is ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION at v0.1.0 under Founder-delegated Gate W2-B (2026-07-24), while RB-001 — the SOC-side Fabric-ingress mapping — remains an OPEN release/integration follow-up, not closed by this acceptance. The request binds capability digest, resolved target snapshot, resolved arguments, policy decision, and delegation chain so that an approval cannot be re-bound to a different action. SOC currently has a SOAR four-eyes approval model (soar_approval_requests) but no Fabric-ingress mapping; that mapping is recorded in the compatibility manifest. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA).

requested_by.description: The agent/service requesting approval. tenant_id required (cross-tenant authorization).

requested_for.description: The principal on whose behalf the action would run.

delegation_ref.description: chain_digest of the delegation chain the action would run under.

resolved_target_digest.description: Digest of the server-resolved target snapshot. The approver decides against THIS snapshot.

expected_impact.description: Human-readable, bounded summary of what the action would do. Advisory display only.

obligations.description: Approval obligations from the policy decision (strategy 05 §5.3).

approver_roles.description: Roles permitted to approve. Vendor-neutral role tokens; SOC maps these to its role set (e.g. soc_manager, tenant_admin).

separation_of_duties.description: If true, no approver may be the requesting actor or the on-behalf-of actor.

expires_at.description: Approval validity horizon. A decision arriving after expiry MUST NOT authorize execution (stale-approval defense).
